content_voiceover: Now we move to CAR T cell therapy. Kymriah, or tisagenlecleucel, is an autologous CD19 directed CAR T cell product that received FDA approval for relapsed or refractory ALL in patients under twenty five years old, based on the pivotal ELIANA trial. At a median follow up of two years, the overall remission rate among evaluable infused patients was an impressive eighty two point three percent, with sixty two percent achieving complete remission and about twenty percent achieving CR with incomplete count recovery. On the right side of the slide you can see the structure of the Kymriah CAR construct. It consists of an extracellular antigen binding domain derived from a single chain variable fragment that specifically recognizes CD19, connected through a hinge and transmembrane domain, and linked intracellularly to a CD3 zeta signaling domain that provides the activation signal needed for T cell killing of the leukemic cells, along with a costimulatory domain that enhances persistence. This engineered receptor allows the patient's own T cells to recognize and destroy CD19 positive leukemic blasts independent of the T cell receptor.
keypoints: Kymriah tisagenlecleucel is FDA approved CD19 CAR-T for relapsed refractory ALL, age under twenty five
ELIANA pivotal trial, median follow up two years
Overall remission rate eighty two point three percent, CR sixty two percent, CRi twenty point three percent
CAR structure: anti-CD19 binding domain, hinge transmembrane domain, CD3 zeta signaling domain
keypoint_voiceover: For boards, know that Kymriah is the CD19 CAR T product approved for pediatric and young adult relapsed refractory ALL, based on ELIANA, with an overall remission rate around eighty two percent. Also be able to recognize the basic CAR architecture, an anti-CD19 binding domain fused to a CD3 zeta signaling domain.
